title: Sign-ins stopped at the MFA step

support.label: no bad-password failures in cloud sign-ins

next_steps: If these were your own sign-ins, complete the MFA prompt when it appears. No password change is needed.
If {account} is a service or automation account, it cannot answer an MFA prompt. Raise a request with the identity team to review how it should authenticate.
If you were not signing in at those times, contact the CSOC now. An MFA prompt you did not start means the correct password was entered by someone else.
